method: Global alignment, bust pre-scale, then ARAP with contact vertices targeted to body surface plus layer offset. Cups bridge the cleavage (push-out only). Pauldron and gem/ring placed rigidly outside the skin.

weights.method: Inverse-distance transfer from skin; cups use the spine-chain mean of the skin beneath them and the pauldron follows one shoulder bone, so both stay rigid; straps and band smoothed across the welded surface.

rigging.method: Inverse-distance transfer from skin; cups use the spine-chain mean of the skin beneath them and the pauldron follows one shoulder bone, so both stay rigid; straps and band smoothed across the welded surface.
